bio:
Maria Magdalena (Grub) Ihrig/Stecher (1759-1801); named 'Mary (m. George Stacher)' in her father's will.

FamilySearch gives Maria Magdalena the dates 6 May 1759 to 27 Dec 1801. It names her two husbands as Johannes Ihrie (1754-1788), whom she married about 1778, and George John Stecher (1764-1830), married about 1790, and has children born at Easton from 1779. A Pennsylvania cemetery record calls her 'Maria-Magdalena Grube Stecher' ([R4-S1]).
